Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for VRDE DRDO Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to express willingness for the VRDE DRDO Junior Research Fellow recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates must express their willingness via email by 27 September 2026 to be considered for the recruitment process.

faq.question: Q2. What is the walk-in date for the VRDE DRDO Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview and document verification are scheduled for 06 October 2026. A further walk-in interview might be held on 07 October 2026 if needed.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a BE/B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering with a valid GATE score or ME/M.Tech in Mechanical Engineering with First Division at both levels.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Junior Research Fellow post is 28 years, with relaxations applicable for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Junior Research Fellow role?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a monthly stipend of Rs. 37,000/- plus House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are available for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 5 vacancies announced for the Junior Research Fellow position at VRDE DRDO.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process involves Document Verification, a Written Test, and a Personal Interview.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for the VRDE DRDO Junior Research Fellow recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the VRDE DRDO located?
faq.answer: The VRDE DRDO is located in Ahilyanagar, Maharashtra, with the pincode 414006.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Carry all original documents, self-attested photocopies of educational certificates, ID proof, and category certificates if applicable, along with passport-size photographs.
